input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Deepen flagship 9 (league-schedule-generator): the break-minimal end of the carry-over/breaks trade (flagships.yaml next item 1)
errors: First capped-search design (hard cap, grounds always carried) froze at the circle method for 12 and 20 teams at the exact minimum; fixed by adding pattern-keeping moves.
A penalty (soft cap) variant and a squeeze from the weighted result were tried and dropped: neither reached the target cap.

Odd leagues: first version mis-counted breaks when a pattern-keeping move moved a bye; fixed by rechecking everything when n is odd; odd leagues then fall back to heavy break weights, since the capped search cannot move a bye.

doc_friction.issue: The league next item named 'French/English break-minimal schemes as starts' as the fix for 20 teams never going under 88 breaks; measuring showed the cause is leg one (46-52 breaks vs 18 minimum), so leg-two start orders alone could not fix it.
run_venture_tests and node --test on carryover+best-of-k take ~4 min; foreground runs hit the 120 s timeout, as warned.

deviations.why: The listed item (French/English leg-two schemes) attacks leg two; the measured bottleneck was leg one's breaks.
deviations.did: Built a carry-over search under a hard break cap for leg one, plus three leg-two start orders (backwards, mirror, mirror with ends swapped) under a season cap.
deviations.result: 18 teams: 2,154-2,674 carry-over at the minimum 48 breaks, below all four Bundesliga seasons (3,474-4,342 at 48); 20 teams weak above ~60 breaks (reported as such).
